description.text: Main courses Chinese Culture and History; Fundamental Law; Introduction to Computing; General Chemistry; Introduction to Aerospace; Probability and Statistics; Linear Algebra; Programming Design Lab; Material Michanics; Analog electronic circuits; Computer Aided Drafting(AutoCAD)

duration.text: The Mechatronics Engineering at Shenyang Aerospace University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate or Bachelor’s Degree Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Bachelor’s Degree Transcript 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: 1. Under the age of 45 2. A B.S. degree or equivalent qualification 3. Able to take courses in English or in Chinese (reaching the 4th level HSK), two letters of recommendation from persons of at least associate professor status.
